We're in the last pass of the close cycle and Finance asked for a short hygiene sweep: we have a small backlog of mid‑to‑late stage opportunities that haven't had activity in 45+ days. If owners don't confirm an update by EOD Monday (7/21), we'll mark them for auto‑expiry in SFDC so Q3 forecasts aren't overstated.

Quick asks:
- Marissa / Vanessa — please review the attached CSV (stale-opps-20250719.csv) and do one of the following per row: claim ownership, update stage/close date with evidence, or set 'Archive' with rationale.
- If you claim and need help (e.g., access to procurement contacts or pricing justification), tag me and I'll loop Solutions/Finance.
- Use the closeproof-template.docx for short evidence (PO timelines, procurement notes). Finance will accept a 1‑page note per deal.

Why this matters: Finance will only include deals with owner confirmation or evidence in the committed rollup for next week's forecast review. No confirmation = auto expiry.

Attachments: stale-opps-20250719.csv (10 rows) — includes close date, stage, last activity, owner column.

Thanks — appreciate a quick pass so we don't have noisy upside in the rollup.

—Sean
